lead: A queue of messages to send: what the user types while the assistant is still answering waits here in order, and can be reordered by dragging the handle (or with the keyboard) or removed. Dragging, keyboard moves and screen reader announcements come from [Sortable](/sortable).

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Drag the handle on the left, or focus it and press <kbd>Space</kbd> to pick up, the arrow keys to move and <kbd>Space</kbd> to drop.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.empty: Hint shown when the queue is empty
styling.item: One message (inside Sortable's content area) and its text
styling.sortable: The list itself, the handle and the dragging state keep Sortable's theme styles
